unit_note: half_life_hours are clinical-scale values used directly in PK. ic50/mtd/organ_toxicity are simulation-scaled so C(t) stays O(1) in the interactive ODE. clinical_ic50_note records published units.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.mechanism: PD-1 blockade; reduces T-cell exhaustion drive
drugs.clinical_ic50_note: Clinical t1/2 ~26 days (pembrolizumab label / popPK). Binding affinity is nM-scale; here IC50 is simulation-scaled occupancy.

provenance.note: Hamid et al., NEJM 2013 (KEYNOTE-001). PK half-life corroborated by 10.1007/s40262-016-0427-y (Ahamadi et al. 2017 popPK).

drugs.name: Galunisertib (LY2157299)
drugs.mechanism: TGF-βRI kinase inhibition; lowers stromal drive and exhaustion
drugs.clinical_ic50_note: Published t1/2 ~8 h; cardiac monitoring was a Phase I constraint.

provenance.note: Rodón et al., Cancer Chemother Pharmacol 2015. First-in-human TGF-βRI inhibitor PK/PD.

drugs.name: AZD3965
drugs.mechanism: MCT1 inhibition; slows lactate export/clearance remodeling
drugs.clinical_ic50_note: Half-life approximated from first-in-human PK (hours-scale). IC50 in vitro is nM; sim-scaled here.

provenance.note: Halford et al., Clin Cancer Res 2023. First-in-human MCT1 inhibitor AZD3965.

drugs.name: Vorinostat (SAHA)
drugs.mechanism: HDAC inhibition; attenuates sensitive→resistant phenotypic switch
drugs.clinical_ic50_note: Clinical t1/2 ~2 h; myelosuppression is dose-limiting.

provenance.note: Mann et al., Clin Cancer Res 2007. Vorinostat PK and HDAC inhibition in advanced cancer.

drugs.name: Trametinib
drugs.mechanism: MEK1/2 inhibition; archetype-mapped cytotoxic pressure on sensitive clones
drugs.clinical_ic50_note: Clinical t1/2 ~4 days. Default kinase channel; melanoma maps most naturally. GBM/PDAC use the same channel as a stand-in for EGFR/MEK-adjacent pressure.

provenance.note: Infante et al., JCO 2012. Trametinib first-in-human / recommended Phase II dose.

drugs.name: Osimertinib
drugs.mechanism: EGFR T790M-selective TKI; GBM-adjacent kinase catalog entry (not in default 5-D U)
drugs.clinical_ic50_note: Clinical t1/2 ~48 h (AURA). Catalog-only; default controller uses trametinib as the shared kinase channel.

provenance.note: Jänne et al., NEJM 2015 (AURA). Included so the catalog has an EGFR-axis kinase with a real DOI.

drugs.name: Supportive care (placeholder)
drugs.mechanism: Non-cytotoxic placeholder for future host-protection channels
drugs.clinical_ic50_note: PLACEHOLDER — not a real oncology agent. Reserved for future host-protection / G-CSF-like channels.
